Method of Attack: Social engineering via spam SMS message with malicious link
Requesting overlay permission to draw over other apps
Requesting additional permissions dynamically after installation
Requesting device administrator rights to steal banking credentials and contacts/SMS
Blocking device functionality if permissions are denied
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Android 6 and above
Attack Vector: Spam SMS message with malicious link
Indicators of Compromise: Spam SMS message text: 'Dear user, you receive MMS-photo! You can look at it by clicking on the following link.'
Overlay permission request window with text 'Additional rights needed to work with graphics and windows' and button 'provide.'
